varieties.title: Varieties
varieties.intro: A variety is a microgreen you grow and sell by the 100 g. This screen owns the numbers only — what it costs, how long it takes, how much a tray yields. Every word a customer reads about it lives in content/varieties/[key].json.
varieties.introOps: Grow days and yield per tray are the two figures the operation computes from. Grow days set the delivery date an ad-hoc order is promised; yield per tray sets how many trays get sown — ceil(grams ordered ÷ yield per tray). Both start as estimates, so revisit them after a few sows.
varieties.pickHint: Lowercase letters and hyphens only — radish, red-amaranth, green-amaranth. No numbers or spaces. This names the content file and the page address, so it is an identifier, not a label.
varieties.howTo: Save it here first, then create content/varieties/[key].json for the name and description and drop photos in public/varieties/[key]/. Until that file exists the variety is flagged below and stays off the site.
varieties.priceHint: Prices ad-hoc orders and Pick Your Own
varieties.seedHint: Optional — adds a seed column to the sow plan
varieties.savedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing saved yet} one {# variety saved} other {# varieties saved}}
varieties.emptyList: Nothing yet. Add a variety above and it appears on the site straight away.
varieties.missingContent: Some varieties have no content file yet, so they are hidden from the site.
varieties.missingContentHint: No copy yet — create content/varieties/{key}.json. Hidden from the site until you do.
varieties.deleteConfirm: This removes its price, yield and grow days. The content file and photos stay on disk, so you can add it back at any time.

errors.keyRequired: Give this variety a key, like radish or red-amaranth.
errors.growDaysInvalid: Grow days must be at least 1.
errors.yieldInvalid: Yield per tray must be at least 1 g.
errors.priceInvalid: Price per 100 g must be a positive number.
errors.keyInvalid: Lowercase letters and hyphens only — no numbers or spaces. For example red-amaranth.

varieties.pickExisting: Existing content files appear as suggestions as you type.

plans.title: Plans
plans.intro: There are three plans and there will only ever be three: Everyday Essentials, Rare & Exotic and Pick Your Own. They are defined by their content files in content/plans/, so this screen does not create or delete them — it sets what you tune. Price, box weight, order, and which varieties go in each of the four weeks.
plans.introRotation: A month is a rotation, not the same box four times. Week 1 carries the quick crops sown on the first Sunday and week 2 the slower ones sown that same Sunday (SPEC §5.2), so pick each week by grow days — the figure beside every variety in the list.
plans.notConfigured: Not set up yet. Add a price and pick the varieties, then save — the plan appears on the home page as soon as you do.
plans.priceHint: Leave empty for Pick Your Own
plans.sortOrderHint: Lower shows first, and sets the card colour
plans.recommendedLabel: Feature this plan — filled badge and a heavier card border
plans.byoLabel: Pick Your Own — priced by weight, no monthly price
plans.rotationHint: Pick the varieties for each week. A week with none picked is not part of the rotation.
plans.noVarieties: Add varieties first — a rotation is built from them.
plans.monthlyPrice: ₹{price, number} a month · ~{grams, number} g a box
plans.missingContentHint: No copy yet — create content/plans/{key}.json. Hidden from the site until you do.
plans.orphanHint: This plan has numbers saved but no content/plans/{key}.json, so nothing about it can be shown to a customer. Restore the file, or delete the row.
plans.deleteConfirm: This removes its price, box weight and rotation. Only offered because the content file is missing — the three real plans cannot be deleted from here.

errors.keyUnknown: That plan is not one of the content files in content/plans/.
errors.priceRequired: A curated plan needs a monthly price, or tick Pick Your Own.
errors.priceInvalid: Monthly price must be a positive number.
errors.gramsInvalid: Grams per box must be at least 1. Pick Your Own is the exception — leave it at 0.
errors.varietyUnknown: "{key}" is not a variety any more. Remove it and save again.
